text:
mara: quick heads-up — console editor is escaping colons in header override values on save. Repro: paste a route YAML with header_overrides containing a value like "team:alpha".

aj: can you paste the minimal repro?

mara: sure — here's the route snippet I used:

```
route:
  match:
    path: /api/*
  header_overrides:
    X-Org-ID: "team:alpha"
```

mara: saved, reopened editor, YAML became:

```
route:
  match:
    path: /api/*
  header_overrides:
    X-Org-ID: "team\:alpha"
```

liam: yeah that's the classic YAML serializer treating the colon as a special char when it's unescaped elsewhere. Seems the console unserializer applies a naive escape on save.

aj: does the server accept both when created via API? ie if you POST the same YAML to the config API, does it persist correctly?

mara: POSTing via admin API keeps it as "team:alpha". Only the console editor roundtrip corrupts it.

liam: probable fix: on save, always quote string values that contain `:` or match regex `[^\"']*:\S`. Also add a lint rule to flag unquoted colons in header overrides during preflight.

mika: UX ask — if we auto-quote, show a transient hint so users understand why their value changed. e.g., tooltip: "value auto-quoted to preserve colon" with :information_source:.

aj: plan: add a unit test in editor-serializer to ensure roundtrip of values with `:` and write a preflight lint rule that fails with actionable message. I'll own the lint rule.

mara: thanks — can you add a small repro harness in infra tests so we catch regressions in CI?

aj: yep. ETA EOD tomorrow for lint + test. will file a follow-up PR and link here.

console-bot: draft saved by aj at 2026-03-20T16:12:03Z

liam: also add a quick integration test that renders the value in the live preview and asserts header doesn't contain backslash escape.

mika: also let's add inline help explaining when you need to quote values manually (JWT kid, namespace ids, etc.).

mara: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
